{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Define target population: new customers reached by paid_search
target_df = df[(df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Check the total count in target population
print(f'Total number of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH: {len(target_df)}')

# Check how many of them are refunded
refunded_in_target = target_df[target_df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of refunded orders in target group: {len(refunded_in_target)}')

# Check how many are QA orders
qa_in_target = target_df[target_df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders in target group: {len(qa_in_target)}')

# The estimand is: fraction of converted in the full target population (all new + paid_search rows)
# Refunded orders are still 'converted' if they completed checkout (converted = 1), so they should be included
# QA orders are not real and should be excluded

# Exclude only QA orders (not refunded ones)
valid_target_df = target_df[~(target_df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)]

# Compute conversion rate
conversion_rate = valid_target_df['converted'].mean()
print(f'Conversion rate among NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH (excluding QA orders): {conversion_rate}')"}
